summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Blue Canyon Technologies LLC from RTX's Raytheon for US$620 million (approx. C$874 million) in an all-cash transaction. The target is a spacecraft and satellite component manufacturer with over 400 employees in Denver, Colorado. The deal is expected to close by end of 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, fully committed via senior secured debt. Pro forma leverage is expected within 1.5x-2.5x net debt to adjusted EBITDA. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risk.
